title: SHOT Aimbot!, Tackle Aimbot, Auto Dribble, ESP
features:
Attack
- Shot Aimbot with shot placement and target post picker
- Perfect Charge: every shot released at full power
- Goal Expander: widens where the aimbot is allowed to aim, with a goal box overlay
- Auto Dribble: dodges for you the moment a defender closes in, range slider

Defense
- Tackle Aimbot
- Steal Reach: extra tackle range, with a reach ring
- Slide Tuning: slide distance and slide speed
- Auto Dive and Catch when you are the goalkeeper, reaction range slider

Visuals
- Player ESP with names and distance, enemies only option
- ESP distance limit and colour pickers
- Fullbright, field of view slider

Movement
- Infinite Stamina, Auto Sprint
- Noclip, No Fall Damage
- Fly with speed slider

Items
- Auto Collect Item Boxes, walk to nearest box
- Dribble Boost: tune the energy drink speed boost

Session
- Anti AFK, Rejoin, Server Hop
